blocks.caption: Table 31.5-3. Buffer Layout for Standard Frame Format and Extended Frame Format

c.v: Table 31.5-3 illustrates the layout of the Transmit Buffer and Receive Buffer registers.
Both the Transmit and Receive Buffer registers share the same address space and are only accessible when the
CPU write operations access the Transmit Buffer registers, and CPU read operations access the Receive Buffer registers.
However, both buffers share the exact same register layout and fields to represent a message (received or to be transmitted).
The Transmit Buffer registers are used to configure a TWAI message to be transmitted.
The CPU would write to the Transmit Buffer registers specifying the message's frame type, frame format, frame ID, and frame data (payload).
